title: promote.intent.created payload (v1)
description: Payload of the promote.intent.created outbox event. Producers (shapes vary genuinely): app/agents/panel_agent/graph.py::_promotion_event (rich shape: note/panel/action/instruction/trust_verb/transition) and app/orchestrator/executor.py (minimal shape: note/action/instruction plus maturity/review_state). Consumer: app/promotion/consumer.py::consume_promotion_intent_payload / _handle_promotion_payload, which reads payload.note (uuid, path, title) with a payload.note_path fallback, payload.transition (family, target_maturity), and optional maturity/review_state/trust_verb. The consumer itself degrades to a PROMOTE_ERROR receipt for a missing note uuid/path rather than crashing, so this schema only pins the structural shape (note/transition must be objects when present) and leaves every field optional so both producer shapes stay valid.
